{{Top|leg}}
The '''Soruus system's provincial government''' that administrated the [[Soruus system/Legends|Soruus system]]. It sentenced criminals to fight to the [[Death/Legends|death]] in large arenas, and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at one point had to organize a hunt for a group of criminals that had escaped from the arenas with prototype [[JX4 Gladiator Prototype|JX4]] personal [[battle armor]] suits and had gone on to commit atrocious crimes.<ref name="Gundark">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
